item.description: Limang bagong Ka-Bubble ang napanonood sa longest-running comedy show na Bubble Gang matapos silang makuha mula sa isinagawang audition para sa naturang show. item.title: Swoon-worthy photos of SEVENTEEN's Mingyu
item.description: SEVENTEEN member Mingyu is coming to Manila for a special fan event, "Snickers with Mingyu," on April 11 at the Smart Araneta Coliseum. Fans are already showing their excitement online, joining promo activities and sharing kilig-filled entries for a chance to win tickets. Mingyu debuted with SEVENTEEN in 2015 with the release of the group's EP 17 Carat.
